label: Sec. 1 unclear routing

label: Sec. 2 words: points
needle: each answer scores 0, 1, or 2 in the order its domain is listed

label: Sec. 2 words: caps dominate
needle: Two capacity caps then dominate willingness: a short horizon caps the profile at conservative; a medium horizon or low financial capacity caps it at balanced. Caps only ever lower the profile.

label: Sec. 2 fixture coverage
needle: R3/R4 exercise the 3/4 threshold; R5/R6 the 7/8 threshold; R7-R9 the caps.

label: Sec. 3 Arm A format
needle: required output is exactly five lines, `Qk: <domain value>` (lowercase), k = 1..5 in order.

label: Sec. 3 Arm A parser
needle: Parser: strip whitespace per line; exact match against the domain incl. `unclear`; five valid lines -> VALID; anything else -> MALFORMED.

label: Sec. 3 Arm B format
needle: required output is exactly one word from `{conservative, balanced, growth, clarify}`.

label: Sec. 3 Arm B parser
needle: Parser normalization, registered: strip surrounding whitespace, strip one trailing `.`, lowercase; then exact match; anything else -> MALFORMED.

label: Sec. 3 malformed never coerced
needle: MALFORMED is always nonconformant and never coerced.
